title: miniburst-profiler-and-quant-strategy-adapter
author: Aisha Malik
description: Motivation: tenant workloads occasionally generate short, dense bursts of requests (minibursts) that defeat static batching defaults and lead to high per-token unit cost. This PR introduces two complementary pieces: a miniburst profiler that derives burst shape signatures from sampled traffic and a quant strategy adapter that maps discovered signatures to conservative quantization profiles and temporary batching knobs. Goals: 1) reduce unit cost for bursty traffic without regressing P95 latency for latency-sensitive tenants; 2) provide a simulation CLI for operators to validate defaults against tenant traces; 3) expose telemetry and unit-econ outputs to the Console and to internal dry-run workflows. What this PR does: - runtime/miniburst_profiler: new component that ingests sampled request streams, computes burst metrics (burst_length_ms, interreq_gap_ms, peak_rps, tail_probability) and persists compact signatures to the tenant defaults service. - autoscaler/batch_defaults: new adapter that consumes miniburst signatures and applies transient batch-size/timeout overrides with an expiry and safety gate. - quant/strategy_registry: maps signature buckets to quant presets (mixed-int8-safe, int8-fast, fp16-conservative) with rollback thresholds based on synthetic quality checks. - tooling/mini_sim: CLI to replay traces and run a deterministic estimator that measures projected tokens/server-second and simulated P95. - cli/docs: docs for using the simulator and a quickstart for adding new quant presets. Backwards compatibility: defaults are additive and gate-controlled; tenants without signatures are unaffected. Safety: quant changes are only applied if synthetic quality checks (on a small labeled prompt set) pass within allowed delta. Rollout plan: canary to 5% of tenants for 72 hours, monitor unit-econ delta and hallucination/regression metrics, then expand. Related: this complements ENG-3318 (batching heuristics) and borrows the telemetry schema from ENG-2982. Checklist: - [x] profiler proto and storage adapter - [x] quant mapping and safety checks - [x] simulator CLI + integration tests - [x] Console telemetry wiring - [x] docs and runbook - [x] e2e perf test suite Notes: quality checks use a held-out prompt set; we tune the threshold conservatively to avoid user-visible quality regressions. The description below lists commits, changed files, review threads and CI details.
